text:
Alex Park: Heads-up — quarterly capacity playbook time. I ran a quick sim for hosted API demand if product launches the new vector search in July.
Priya Shah: share the numbers?
Alex Park: Baseline Q3 GPU-hours 1.1M. Marketing-driven surge scenario -> peak week multiplier 2.8x; total Q3 1.6M. Assumes 6% bot traffic and 12% cache hit improvement from Redwood Optimize.
Jordan Lee: procurement lead time still 12–16 weeks for A100 80GB, right?
Samira Gomez: yes from the current vendors. For lease options we can get 6–8 week delivery but higher monthly cost.
Matt R.: what are the price deltas?
Alex Park: rough: buy capex per A100 80GB node ~ $40k (incl rack+network), lease equivalent ~ $3.7k/mo/node. With 24/7 utilization break-even ~18 months.
Priya Shah: do we have region constraints? EU customers prefer local; vendors quoting limited EU availability in Aug.
Jordan Lee: EU shortage in vendor pipeline — recommend mixing buys in US + leases in EU to avoid shortage risk.
Samira Gomez: also flag: network egress limits in eu-west1; our perf tests saw 12% higher tail latency when cross-region KV cache misses happened. Need local warm-pools.
Alex Park: proposal: commit to buy 120 nodes (US-heavy) and lease 40 nodes for EU warm-pool for Q3. Leaves us ~15% headroom for unexpected spikes.
Matt R.: financial ops — can we structure leases as convertible purchase? Saves cost long term.
Priya Shah: procurement-bot: please run RFP for convertible leases and confirm vendor SLA for <15ms p50 latency targets.
procurement-bot: RFP created (ID: RFP-2026-67). Expect vendor responses in 7 business days.
Jordan Lee: ops TODOs: prioritize CI perf runs on mixed fleet images, verify KV cache distribution, adjust autoscaler thresholds for warm-pool spin-up.
Samira Gomez: also add a canary region plan: route 5% traffic to leased EU nodes first week, monitor token throughput and GPU saturation.
Alex Park: putting a decision sync tomorrow 10am PT. If we greenlight buy+lease blend we'll start PO and lease signoffs same week.
Priya Shah: noted. I'll prepare cost sensitivity table (CAPEX vs OPEX, 12/18/24 month horizons) and bring to sync.
Matt R.: +1. Also include failure-mode costs (eg. cross-region outages) in sensitivity.
Alex Park: thanks all. Filing the sim and numbers to the capacity runbook now: https://internal.redwood/capacity/q3-2026-sim
Samira Gomez: :thumbsup:
